stability: Fields are only added; ignore those you do not know. A change that could break a consumer raises schema, announced in the README at least 30 days ahead.

record.description: A repository and its releases; mods/codeberg.org/{owner}/{repo}.json and mods/gitlab.com/{path}.json off GitHub

knownBad.description: Jars confirmed to do harm, by sha256; never install one

withheld.description: Repositories withheld as takedowns; already left out of every list

optedOut.description: Repositories that opted out; already left out of every list

explanations.description: Authors' explanations of findings, by mod and finding; absent until one is approved

packRecord.description: A pack repository and the pack in each format it has

packPage.description: A pack summary with every mod it names

renames.description: Renamed repositories, old name to new
